CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION genui_private.resolve_code(p_code_digest text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STRICT SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid;
BEGIN
 SELECT i.organization_id INTO v_org FROM genui_private.code_index i WHERE i.code_digest=p_code_digest;
 RETURN v_org;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION genui_private.resolve_handle(p_handle_digest text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STRICT SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid;
BEGIN
 SELECT h.organization_id INTO v_org FROM genui_private.handle_index h
  WHERE h.handle_digest=p_handle_digest AND (h.retired_at IS NULL OR h.retired_at>now());
 RETURN v_org;
END $function$
